The '''1950–51 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 6th edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 10 teams.

[[Kjøbenhavns Boldklub]] unsuccessfully defended its [[1949-50 Danish 1st Division|1950 title]]. [[Akademisk Boldklub]] successfully pursued its 1951 title.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1950/1951 season.
